title.en: Simple harmonic motion and uniform circular motion
title.kn: ಸರಳ ಸಂನಾದಿ ಚಲನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಏಕರೂಪ ವೃತ್ತೀಯ ಚಲನೆ

heading.en: The shadow of a spinning ball

hook.en: Tie a ball to a string and whirl it in a horizontal circle under a lamp. Its shadow on the wall just moves back and forth. That shadow is doing simple *harmonic motion*.
hook.kn: ದೀಪದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ದಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ ಚೆಂಡನ್ನು ಸಮತಲ ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ. ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಅದರ ನೆರಳು ಹಿಂದೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ನೆರಳು ಸರಳ ಸಂನಾದಿ ಚಲನೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದೆ.

say.en: Tie a ball to a string and whirl it in a horizontal circle under a lamp. Its shadow on the wall just moves back and forth. That shadow is doing simple harmonic motion. In this lesson: Write the displacement of SHM: x equals A cosomega t plus phi.
Identify amplitude, phase and angular frequency.
Link SHM to uniform circular motion.

body.en: In simple harmonic motion the *displacement* from the mean position is a sinusoidal function of time: x(t) = A cos(ωt + φ). A is the amplitude (the largest displacement), ωt + φ is the phase, φ is the phase constant (the phase at t = 0), and ω = 2π/T = 2πν is the angular frequency in rad s⁻¹.
body.kn: ಸ.ಸಂ.ಚ.ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾನಪಲ್ಲಟ x(t) = A cos(ωt + φ). A ಕಂಪನ ವಿಸ್ತಾರ, ωt + φ ಹಂತ, φ ಹಂತ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ, ω = 2π/T ಕೋನೀಯ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ.

points.en: ωt + φ: phase; φ: phase constant

A is the amplitude the largest displacement, omega t plus phi is the phase, phi is the phase constant the phase at t equals 0, and omega equals 2 pi /T equals 2 pi nu is the angular frequency in rad s to the power minus 1. A: amplitude.

omega equals 2 pi /T equals 2 pi nu.

title.en: SHM is the shadow of circular motion

say.en: A particle P moves round a circle of radius A at a steady angular speed omega.
Drop a perpendicular onto the diameter. The foot of it, the shadow, moves to and fro along the diameter.
The shadow is at x = A cos of omega t plus phi. That is simple harmonic motion. A is the amplitude and phi the phase constant.
Two SHMs with the same omega but different phi look the same, only shifted in time.
Example: x = 0.05 cos of 10 pi t plus pi by 3. Amplitude 5 centimetres, frequency 5 hertz, period 0.2 seconds, and at t = 0, x = 2.5 centimetres.

title.en: SHM is a shadow of circular motion

narration.en: A point P goes round a circle of radius A at constant angular speed ω. Its projection on a diameter moves to and fro in simple harmonic motion, y = A sin(ωt + φ): the radius is the amplitude, ω the angular frequency and the starting angle φ the phase constant.
narration.kn: P ಬಿಂದು A ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯದ ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಕೋನೀಯ ವೇಗ ω ದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ವ್ಯಾಸದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ ಸರಳ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನಿಕ್ ಚಲನೆ y = A sin(ωt + φ): ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ ಕಂಪನ ವಿಸ್ತಾರ, ω ಕೋನೀಯ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ, ಆರಂಭ ಕೋನ φ ಹಂತ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ.

title.en: SHM as a shadow of circular motion

body.en: A particle moving uniformly on a circle of radius A with angular speed ω has its projection on any diameter moving as x = A cos(ωt + φ). So SHM is the projection of uniform *circular motion* on a diameter, and the amplitude equals the radius of the circle.
body.kn: A ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯದ ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ω ಕೋನೀಯ ಜವದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಲಿಸುವ ಕಣದ ವ್ಯಾಸದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ ಸ.ಸಂ.ಚ. ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಂಪನ ವಿಸ್ತಾರ = ವೃತ್ತದ ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ.

problem.en: A particle moves as x = 0.05 cos(4πt + π/4) m. Find its amplitude, angular frequency, period, frequency and phase constant.

steps.en: Compare with x = A cos(ωt + φ): A = 0.05 m, ω = 4π rad s⁻¹, φ = π/4.

answer.en: A = 5 cm, ω = 4π rad s⁻¹, T = 0.5 s, ν = 2 Hz, φ = π/4

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A particle moves as x = 0.05 cos(4πt + π/4) m. Find its amplitude, angular frequency, period, frequency and phase constant.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A particle moves as x equals 0.05 cos(4 pi t plus pi /4) m. Find its amplitude, angular frequency, period, frequency and phase constant.
Compare with x equals A cosomega t plus phi: A equals 0.05 metres, omega equals 4 pi rad s to the power minus 1, phi equals pi /4.
T equals 2 pi divided by omega equals 2 pi /4 pi equals 0.5 seconds.
nu equals 1 over T equals 2 hertz.
So the answer is A equals 5 centimetres, omega equals 4 pi rad s to the power minus 1, T equals 0.5 seconds, nu equals 2 hertz, phi equals pi /4.
